digest: Wall Street suffered a brutal week with the Dow and S&P 500 entering correction territory and the Nasdaq enduring its worst week since 2020.
Chip stocks experienced a massive $2.3 trillion weekly wipeout as a panic gripped the AI trade.
Nvidia shares slid further amid reports of an SEC accounting probe and a historic streak of weekly losses.
Anthropic held its record IPO during a historic tech rout that saw major indexes turn red for the year.
M&A activity continued in the security sector as CrowdStrike reportedly held talks to acquire Zscaler.
